scripts.css: npx --yes tailwindcss@3.4.17 -i ./css/input.css -o ./css/utilities.css --minify && cat css/utilities.css css/site.components.css css/a11y.css > css/site.css
scripts.build: npm run css && python3 scripts/build-bonaire-site.py && python3 scripts/generate-book-pages.py && python3 scripts/sync-public-assets.py
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run check && wrangler deploy
scripts.bookings:migrate:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply bonaire-bookings-test --remote --config workers/bookings/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.bookings:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply bonaire-bookings-prod --remote --config workers/bookings/wrangler.prod.jsonc
